reason: Close KF-P0-19 by failure-first proof against exact trusted main 29ce90a772be28cbddc925459721045b086f8104. Fresh same-root source review shows every Baileys callback is registered through createSocketGenerationGuard, which blocks callbacks that are already stale at entry, but the guard does not own or drain an async callback once it is in flight. In particular, the production creds.update handler awaits Baileys saveCreds(update), which performs asynchronous shared credential-directory persistence, and only afterwards asserts that the socket generation is still current. stop/restart invalidates the generation but does not wait for already-started guarded callbacks to quiesce before a replacement generation may start. The same-root audit also found account-state/history async continuations whose awaited work may complete before a post-await generation assertion. The first implementation must remain tests-only and prove the in-flight custody boundary while preserving current entry-time stale rejection and all Facebook/Telegram existing session-fence semantics. Production remains forbidden until fresh exact-head causal RED evidence closes the diagnostic window with unknownBlockers=0 and a separate same-work-package production amendment ordinary-merges.

requiredSemantics: Use the existing sessionGenerationFence/createSocketGenerationGuard and WhatsAppAdapter runtime seams; do not create a second session fence, scheduler, process, queue, retry engine or lock authority.

Prove that an async Baileys callback which was current at entry but remains in flight when stop/restart invalidates its generation cannot overlap replacement-generation side effects after the stop boundary returns.
Bind the diagnostic to the real WhatsApp creds.update persistence seam where saveCreds(update) is awaited before the current production post-await socketGuard assertion.
Batch any additional same-root async account-state/history boundary discovered by the diagnostic window when it is demonstrated to perform a real side effect before post-await generation validation.
Preserve the existing behavior that callbacks already stale at entry have zero effects and late completions are quarantined without unhandled stale errors.
Preserve Facebook Relay and Telegram existing session-generation behavior as negative/protection evidence; no Facebook or Telegram production path is authorized by this diagnostic.
The first implementation commit must change only the dedicated authorized WP0 test path and contain no production mutation.
Stage WP0 must isolate only finding-specific in-flight stale-socket custody failures; all unrelated mandatory WP0 tests must pass before unknownBlockers may be recorded as zero.
forbiddenSemantics: No production fix before fresh exact-head causal RED evidence and unknownBlockers=0.
No assertion-only workaround that merely moves socketGuard.assertCurrent before an asynchronous side effect while still allowing that side effect to overlap generation replacement.
No new credential store, auth directory, lock authority, queue, scheduler or retry engine.
No Facebook Relay, Telegram, platformDriverRegistry, adapter registry or physical-egress authority mutation.
No dependency, workflow, routing, schema, package or lockfile change.
No weakening of stop/restart, persisted credential, session generation or existing batch39 stale-callback contracts.
